propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple lifecycle concerns (identity transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, tombstones, unretire) that should be extracted into a cohesive private policy owner in binding_lifecycle.py

Production rich-text convergence mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings(), bypassing policy seams; a narrow named operation like note_rich_emit() must become the supported mutation entry point while preserving all_bindings() compatibility
Lifecycle policy must maintain at-most-one identity per binding through targeted single-key reverse pops, without detecting or refusing ambiguous double binds, matching existing production behavior
Comment IDs must remain append-only and change-gated; legacy entries without the field must remain readable; tombstoned issues must suppress recreate with alert until explicit unretire
The facade must preserve exact current failure modes: confirmed 404 grace/reset, moved-key repair, retired corruption fail-open, live corruption fail-closed, and tombstone suppression/unretire
Public BindingStore signatures and shallow all_bindings() semantics must remain unchanged; no callers receive direct writable repository objects
